question.text: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, how far in advance of scheme launch must an AIF file its PPM with SEBI through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker?

answer.text: At least 7 days prior to launch of scheme
At least 30 days prior to launch of scheme
At least 15 days prior to launch of scheme
At least 60 days prior to launch of scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations (Section 13.5), the Investment Manager or Sponsor shall launch AIF schemes after filing the PPM with SEBI, through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker, at least 30 days prior to launch of the scheme, along with payment of the scheme fee. SEBI may communicate observations on the PPM within this window which the Merchant Banker must then incorporate. The Trap: 7 and 15 days are confusing shorter-window distractors but are not the AIF PPM filing rule. 60 days is not the AIF Merchant Banker filing requirement. Note: The filing route is mandatory: PPM goes to SEBI through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker, accompanied by the scheme fee, at least 30 days before launch.
